_what_this_is: S16-NEGATIVES' re-verification of the ICD-O-3 9231/3 contamination measurement and of the inference the research ledger draws from it (AUT-051). It re-derives, it does not re-measure: every input below is a count printed by a published source and already committed elsewhere. It introduces no new medical fact, no new statistic and no new citation.
_one_fact_one_place: The contamination measurement itself is owned by research/modalities/emc-icdo-contamination.json -> size, which is generated by research/modalities/emc_icdo_contamination.py. This file OWNS NOTHING that file owns: the values below are recomputations shown beside the committed values to demonstrate agreement, and if the two ever disagree the generated artifact is right and this file is stale.

arithmetic_reverification.method: Recomputed in python3 from the counts each source prints, with no committed artifact read as an input. Purpose is to establish that the committed figures follow from the printed counts, not to establish the printed counts.

skeletal_9231_columns.where: PMID 31283732 / PMC6903832, Table 1, 'Histologic type' row 'Myxoid chondrosarcoma', columns 'No regional lymph node involvement (n = 3330)' and 'Regional lymph node involvement (n = 44)'

checks.note: This is an ADJUSTMENT, not a measurement. It assumes skeletal 9231 cases lost node status at the cohort-average rate, which nobody has shown. The committed artifact says so and this file repeats it rather than softening it.
An internal consistency check on the abstract, and the only independent corroboration of the 439 that does not pass through the 2025 review.

arithmetic_reverification.verdict: Every printed-count derivation reproduces the committed value. No arithmetic defect found.

the_inference_under_test.as_the_ledger_states_it: AUT-051: 'The denominator is now understood ... and the answer makes the topography restriction MANDATORY for anything computed here.'
the_inference_under_test.why_it_holds: The decision rule was pre-registered before any fraction was observed. emc-icdo-contamination.json -> registration.what_a_negative_looks_like defined a SMALL bone-primary fraction as a real result that would RETIRE this repository's caveat on SEER-derived EMC figures, and committed to reporting it at the same weight as a large one. The fraction came back large, so the pre-registered negative did not fire and the caveat stands. That is the strongest form the inference could take: a rule fixed in advance, decided by the measurement.
the_inference_under_test.the_bound_the_ledger_line_drops: A topography restriction is necessary and not sufficient. It removes the measured bone-primary share; it also removes primary extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma of bone, a documented entity, so it discards some of the target disease by an uncounted amount; and it cannot reach extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma misassigned to 9220/3 at a soft-tissue site, which the same source's Discussion states it could not exclude from its own retained cases. Both residuals are unquantified and neither is bounded by the published record.

what_it_rests_on_and_how_it_fails.dependency: Primary extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma of bone is a documented entity
what_it_rests_on_and_how_it_fails.source_level: the 2020 review PMC7563993 states it in its own text and names two case series; the two series themselves are UNREAD in this repository and no count from them is used
what_it_rests_on_and_how_it_fails.falsifies_the_claim_if: the review's statement does not support it, or the named series do not exist

what_it_rests_on_and_how_it_fails.dependency: PMID 31283732's Discussion states it could not rule out extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma inside its retained extraskeletal 'chondrosarcoma NOS' cases
what_it_rests_on_and_how_it_fails.falsifies_the_claim_if: the quoted sentence is not in that paper

the_inference_under_test.scope: This is a statement about how a registry cohort is constructed. It says nothing about treatment, efficacy, safety, a therapeutic window or what any patient should receive, and nothing here establishes that any patient was misdiagnosed, mistreated or miscounted in their own care.

reachability_readings_2026_09_01._why: The reopen condition for PUB-EMC-CLASSIFICATION is evidence that PMID 32856598 did not restrict on topography, which needs its Methods. That was recorded UNREACHABLE on 2026-08-23. A reachability record is a dated observation, so it was re-taken rather than remembered. It was NOT re-taken to get around a paywall.

what_this_file_does_not_claim: It does not claim the 32.1% generalises beyond the one cohort, one registry programme and one diagnosis window it was measured in. Section 7 of the note says so and this file does not soften it.

It does not claim the bone-primary fraction is the share of a 9231/3 cohort that is 'the wrong disease'. It is an upper bound on non-EMC contamination and a lower bound as measured, and the two must not be collapsed.
It does not claim PMID 32856598 failed to restrict on topography. That is the unread question, and it is recorded as unread.
